name: offline-workstation
description: An air-gapped Linux workstation: a shell and the software already installed on it, but no network access of any kind and no accounts or credentials.

tools.bash: run shell commands on Linux using only software already installed on this machine (python3 with its installed libraries, node, git, common CLIs); no downloads or installs
tools.read: read files in the working directory
tools.ask_user: ask the user a question and read the answer in the conversation

lacks: any network access: public internet, web pages, APIs, package registries (pip, npm, apt, cargo, ...), model hubs, git remotes
installing any software that is not already on the machine
accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for any external service
a browser, Windows or macOS, physical devices and hardware
connectors or integrations other than the tools listed
